name: Caja y guacharaca
desc: Colombian cumbia percussion bed: soft caja kick pulsing 1 and 3, the guacharaca scraping its short-short-LONG cell (vcsl guiro at varied speeds), and woodblock cáscara accents — sonidera tempo, more porch than club. Peak adds conga slaps and doubles the scrape.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ bd ~").gain(${gain}*.65).shape(.35), s("[guiro guiro guiro@2]*4").speed("[1.5 1.5 .85]*4").gain(${scrape}).hpf(1200).pan(.62), s("~ woodblock ~ [~ woodblock]").gain(${gain}*.45).speed("<1 1.2>").pan(.4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ bd ~").gain(${gain}*.7).shape(.4), s("[guiro guiro guiro@2]*4").speed("[1.5 1.5 .85]*4").gain(${scrape}).hpf(1100).pan(.62), s("~ woodblock ~ [woodblock woodblock]").gain(${gain}*.5).speed("<1 1.2 1.1>").pan(.4), s("~ ~ [conga conga] <~ conga>").gain(${gain}*.5).speed("<1 1.15>").pan(.5)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
